name: Alpha Pagination
description: Provides an alphabetic (A-Z) paginator in the global (header/footer) area of a View.
project_description: The Alpha Pagination for Views module enables you to add an alphabetical (A-Z) menu in the header or footer area of a Views display, so a listing can be jumped to by the first character of a chosen field. It provides a Views global area handler (Global: Alpha Pagination) and a companion Views field handler (Alpha Pagination group), plus a shared AlphaPagination helper service. It works with any base entity (nodes, users, comments, taxonomy terms, media) by driving the paginator off a text/string field and a single-character glossary contextual filter. Numeric items, an "All" item, empty-letter toggling, per-element CSS classes and token-driven link paths/attributes are all configurable on the area handler. An optional alpha_pagination_sample_view submodule ships a ready-made example view against the article content type. This module exists thanks to the support of Highwire Press, Inc. and the Institute for the Arts and Humanities at UNC and was created as part of the Symposiac Conference Platform.
